issues.description: In solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, the getters getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() are declared private, but the problem statement requires students to "implement getters for each attribute" (intended to be publicly accessible as part of the Lecture API, and typically required by tests). This visibility mismatch can lead students to implement public getters that differ from the provided reference solution, or cause confusion about the intended method signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the access modifiers of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() in the solution to public (and ensure all getters are public) to match the intended public API implied by the problem statement and expected by tests.
